PASTHIST.TITLE: Hardware Engineer
PASTHIST.DESC:
Designed and implemented Xilinx Virtex II FPGA chip for WinCom
Web Server systems. After receiving HTTP and TCP requests, it loads
¯les from RAID storage via SCSI interface, and sends data to the TCP
interface. It involves much consideration for load balancing, caching
and pre-fetching technology

PASTHIST.TITLE: Senior Software Engineer
PASTHIST.DESC:
Designed and implemented ATM traffic management system with Verilog in Xilinx FPGA Virtex II 3000 for CopperCom Gateway ATM line card. The traffic-shaping algorithm was designed to handle ATM traffic types CBR, VBR and weight proportional bandwidth allocation for large number of channels (VCI and VPI). Developed highly parallel pipeline heap operations technology and multi-heap architecture that is extremely efficient to control timing, priority and fairness for a large number queues during network traffic scheduling.Designed and implemented network bridge protocol according to IEEE
standard 802.1D in the VxWorks environment. The implementation includes packet forwarding, learning process, and bridge management and spanning tree algorithm. It interacts with Mux protocol and pro-
vides END driver interface of VxWorks real-time OS.

Palo Alto, California,Designed money recognition algorithm for ASIC design, which is embedded into copier and printer driver for preventing copying currencies of many countries. The recognition algorithm was granted a US
patent. Patent #6,370,271.

Implemented a virtual mouse system for presentation that contains a LCD projector, laptop, and an embedded camera. The image calibration algorithm is used for ASIC design embedded in the LCD projector,
and was granted a US patent. Patent #6,292,171.

CONGRANT.TITLE: RET site: Research Experiences for Teachers in Embedded Systems Engineering
“RET site: Research Experiences for Teachers in Embedded Systems Engineering,
Homeland and Personal Security Based on Wireless Data Transmission
CONGRANT.ABSTRACT:
We plan to develop a computational model and system for the personal security which com-
bines GPS tracking, image, audio and video management over a wireless network. This system
will involve both hardware and software that will, in case of a security threat, silently record and
send encrypted GPS, audio, image, and video data into a nearest available distributed server from
mobile devices such as smart phones and smart watches. The data then can be managed to provide
necessary information to authorized concerned party and law enforcement. A simple user inter-
face will be provided for smartphones and smartwatches. This system has applications to improve
homeland security. There are many other uses for this proposed system; personal security, campus
security, car-pool security, are among them.

Exponential Time Approximation Scheme for TSP
INTELLCONT.TITLE_SECONDARY: Lecture Notes in Computer Science 11640, Springer 2019, ISBN 978-3-030-27194-7
INTELLCONT.EDITORS: Ding-Zhu Du, Lian Li, Xiaoming Sun, Jialin Zhang
INTELLCONT.ABSTRACT: In this paper, we develop an exponential time approximation scheme for the traveling salesman problem (TSP) on undirected graphs. If the weight of each edge is a nonnegative real number, then there is an algorithm to give an (1+ϵ) approximation for the TSP problem in O(1ϵ⋅1.66n) and a polynomial space. It is in contrast to Golovnen’s approximation scheme for TSP on directed graphs with O(1ϵ⋅2n) time. We also show that there is no 2o(n) time constant factor approximation for the TSP problem under Exponential Time Hypothesis in complexity theory.
